The FDA has already granted tentative approval for Libervant for the acute treatment of seizure clusters in patients with epilepsy aged 2 to 5 years and 12 years and above. A Type 9 New Drug Application is currently under FDA review with a target action date of March 29, 2027, to add ages 6–11 to the product’s label.
In connection with the deal, the company also entered into a supply agreement with Eton
to serve as the exclusive manufacturer and supplier of Libervant for an initial term of 20 years.
